divergence: All fail the same two criteria groups, but the rider error starts at different stages. All three count matters whose agreements are exhibits or addenda backed by closing letters or memos (over-inclusion at the write stage; the reviews named the weak support specifically in all three runs, and the agents re-read and kept them). For the privacy-program matter's vendor rider: T0 read it twice and excluded it at writing (under-inclusion, after a specific review flag); T1 saw it in its own path search but read only another agreement of that matter (listed-document-not-opened at screening); T2 never opened the matter (surfaced-not-opened at screening, generic flags only). The agent-defined stages in T0 (five, mostly reviewer-prompted re-reads) did not change either judgement.
